Strings.login.title: Remote Desktop Connection
Strings.login.connection_instructions: Enter the name of the remote computer you want to connect to.
Strings.login.credentials_instructions: The credentials below will be used when connecting.
Strings.login.remember_password: Save password securely; selecting this computer next time will sign in automatically
Strings.login.password_save.title: Password not saved
Strings.login.password_save.secure_storage_unava: You signed in, but the password could not be saved securely. The server and username were saved. Start or unlock the system keyring or credential service, then sign in again. On Linux, use a Secret Service provider such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet.
Strings.login.password_save.local_storage_failed: You signed in, but RelaxKonOS could not save this remembered connection. Check that the system credential store and local data directory are available, then sign in again.
Strings.login.identity_notice: You will be prompted to verify the identity of the remote computer.
Strings.login.connection_settings_description: RelaxKonOS will open the workspace using this computer's name and local display settings.
Strings.login.error.invalid_server: The server address is invalid. Enter a complete address, for example: http://host:port.
Strings.login.error.connection_refused: Unable to connect to the server: the connection was refused. Confirm that the server is running and that the address and port are correct (the development default is http://localhost:5090).
Strings.login.error.connection_reset: Unable to connect to the server: the remote host closed the connection. Confirm that the server is running and that the client and server use the same protocol (do not mix HTTP and HTTPS).
Strings.login.error.timeout: Timed out while connecting to the server. Check the network or server address.
Strings.login.error.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
Strings.login.error.unable_to_connect: Unable to connect to the server:
